digest.component_or_area: plan clarity and readiness validation gates
propositions: Empty joined checklist item bodies in Acceptance Criteria sections must fail standalone clarity and block plan-review P1 readiness
Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) appearing as values in active execution sections must fail standalone clarity and block plan-review P1 readiness
Sentinel matches must be suppressed when the same line contains negation or removal terms (no, zero, remove, delete, reject, forbid, must not, without)
Code blocks (fenced and inline backtick) must be excluded from sentinel scanning to avoid false positives on prose documentation
A shared pure plan-structure parser must enforce both standalone clarity and deterministic P1 gates without changing ticket-type exemptions or legacy compatibility scoring
